options.title: What if Africa split in two?
options.first_line: What if Africa split in two?
options.first_frame: The whole map of Africa, and a glowing crack runs down its east side from Ethiopia towards Tanzania.

options.title: What if Africa's crack never stopped?
options.first_line: What if the crack in Africa never stopped?
options.first_frame: Close on a crack in the desert ground of Ethiopia, the map of Africa around it, the crack splitting further as we watch.

options.title: What if the sea poured into Ethiopia?
options.first_line: What if the sea poured into the middle of Ethiopia?
options.first_frame: The Red Sea on the map of the Horn of Africa spills over the coast into the Afar desert of Ethiopia, water running inland.

why: Everyone can picture the whole of Africa, the glowing crack down its east side reads instantly with the sound off, and the title asks how a continent could split without giving the answer away.
